name: Austin Russo
source: "I might not be able to take you out on a date, but I'm the most romantic guy you'll ever meet. I'm a poet, a lover...and I've been wrongly accused of murder. I know it's a lot to ask, but you might be the only person who can save my life."
translation: "I might not be able to take you out on a date, but I'm the most romantic guy you'll ever meet. I'm a poet, a lover...and I've been wrongly accused of murder. I know it's a lot to ask, but you might be the only person who can save my life."
